definitions.gloss: to roll up, to wrap up in
definitions.explanation: To wind or wrap something into something else.
To get someone involved in a situation, often against their will.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: I got caught up in an incident.

examples.japanese: {周|まわ}りを{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まないでください。
{髪|かみ}がドライヤーに{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: My hair got caught in the hair dryer.

notes:
{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む is a compound verb meaning to roll/wrap something in, or to involve someone in a situation.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Formed from {巻|ま}く (to wind) + {込|こ}む (into)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む: to involve someone in ~
- 〜に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to get caught up in ~ (passive)
- {周|まわ}りを{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む: to involve those around you
- {事件|じけん}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to get caught up in an incident

USAGE NOTE:
The passive form {巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる is very common and often implies being involuntarily dragged into a situation, whether a conflict, accident, or trouble.
